summary.text: Shannon Maness is a Republican member of the Montana House of Representatives who has represented District 70 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A business owner, he previously served as a trustee on the Dillon school board.

paragraphs.text: Maness earned a bachelor's degree in animal science from the University of Georgia in 1999.

His career experience includes working as a horse trainer, real estate agent, UPS delivery driver, hunting guide and manager of a recreational ranch, and in 2018 he started his own business, Blacktail Appliance Repair.

Maness served as an elected trustee of the Dillon Elementary School Board, as finance chairman of the Beaverhead County Republican Central Committee, as youth hunt coordinator for a local Pheasants Forever chapter, as secretary of the Dillon/Butte Montana Landlords Association, and as a church deacon.

Ballotpedia lists his time on the Dillon School District 10 board as ending in 2025. In the House he was assigned to the Natural Resources, Fish, Wildlife and Parks, and Business and Labor committees.
